We are currently looking for an experienced .NET Developer with strong MAUI and/or Xamarin expertise to join a global FMCG client on a customer-facing mobile application project.
 Key Requirements 
Strong experience with C# and .NET 
Hands-on development using .NET MAUI and/or Xamarin 
Experience integrating REST APIs is a plus
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments is a plus
 Nice to Have 
FMCG, retail, or e-commerce experience
Experience with customer portals, mobile performance optimization, and push notifications
Contract Details:
 Start Date: ASAP
 Duration: Initial 9 Months
 Hours per Week: 40 Hours
 Location: Remote
 Type of Contract: Freelancer / Contractor
 Interview Availability: Friday 2 October & Monday 5 October
 Interested? If you, or someone you know is interested in this position please apply via the link, or feel free to reach out directly with an updated CV to Francesco Leone, f.leone(at)globalenterprisepartners.com or contact me directly on +31 6 15 62 54 68.
